description: Whether a field is open, from the FAA's NASR APT_BASE.csv ARPT_STATUS: O operational is open; CI closed indefinitely, CP closed permanently and any other code are closed, and a closed field is never shown or offered as an open one (the owner's hard rule, decision 0043): hidden from the map and every list, and where it appears at all (a search for its ident, its card) labelled with `closed`. `status` null where NASR has no record of the field: not judged, open, unlabelled.

status.description: NASR APT_BASE's ARPT_STATUS (O, CI, CP); null where NASR has no record.

open.description: Whether the field may be shown or offered as an open one.

closed.description: A closed field's label: Closed indefinitely, Closed permanently, or Closed; null for an open one.
